summary: RptStaffList is a user control for generating staff list reports in a web application. It allows authorized users to select a department and run a report showing staff information. Access and visibility are managed based on user session attributes, such as role and department access.
purpose: Enable users (DC or Supervisors) to generate and view staff lists for a selected department. It facilitates reporting for staff management and oversight.

actors.name: Local Admin
roles: Can monitor/switch users, restricted from running reports when monitoring

workflows.name: Generate Staff List Report
steps: If UserSession allows all departments, display all departments; otherwise, display only user's departments.
Populate department dropdown (ddDepartment) and select user’s default department.
If user has DC or Supervisor privileges, generate the staff list report for selected department.
If user lacks privileges, display error message.

business_rules: At least one staff role (DC or Supervisor) must be selected to run report.
Users monitoring another user (via SwitchUserViewOnly) cannot run reports.
validations: Error message shown if no staff role selected when running report.

conditions.impact: cmdRunReport is hidden; user cannot run reports.
Department dropdown populated with all departments.

system_behavior: cmdRunReport button visibility controlled by user session status.
Department dropdown data-bound on first load.
Client-side JavaScript setup for department dropdown.
Reports generated only for authorized roles and departments.

exceptions.exception: User tries to run report without required role

exceptions.handling: Report button hidden, cannot run reports
